caller_census.limitations: No global instruction-boundary, reachability, indirect-reference or address-taken census; the whole caller CFG is unbound.
caller_census.method: all byte positions with a complete rel32; focused contexts decoded separately

assumptions: Readable right[0:32], readable/writable left[0:32], writable output[0:33], valid return stack.
The three buffers are pairwise disjoint and do not overlap executable code or the return-address slot; ordinary stable memory without concurrent mutation.
Little-endian limbs in increasing significance; no claim about the original Rust type or ABI.
rule.register_result: RAX retains the last loaded right limb; no scalar integer result in RAX is claimed.
rule.result_relation: left := (left - right) mod 2**256; output[0:32] := left; output[32] := int(original_left < original_right)

source_context.scope: A first-party Location reference in the same caller FDE; not a recovered function name or proof of leaf ownership.
